jobs.title: Business Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sieve is a multi-modal lab curating the world's highest-quality training datasets — spanning video, audio, images, text, and 3D. We combine exabyte-scale data infrastructure and novel multimodal understanding techniques that push the frontier of foundation models. Video alone makes up 80% of internet traffic, and across modalities, data has become the enabling medium powering creativity, communication, gaming, AR/VR, and robotics. Sieve exists to solve the biggest bottleneck in the growth of these applications: high-quality training data.

We partner with top AI labs and did $XXM last quarter alone, as a team of ~30 people. We also raised our Series A from Tier 1 firms such as Matrix Partners, Swift Ventures, Y Combinator, and AI Grant.




WHY NOW

Sieve is one of the most capital-efficient teams in AI — roughly 30 people serving the world's leading AI labs across every major data modality. We're growing fast, and the systems, processes, and functions that got us here won't be the ones that get us to the next stage. You'll join at the point where you can have outsized leverage: close enough to leadership to shape decisions, hands-on enough to build the functions that don't exist yet.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As part of our Business Operations team , you'll work directly with our executive team to translate strategic priorities into operational reality. This isn't a scheduling or note-taking role, you'll own ambiguous, cross-functional problems end-to-end, stand up new functions from scratch, and bring rigor to how the company operates as it scales.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work directly with leadership team to identify, prioritize, and drive the company's strategic initiatives

 - Build and own new operational functions as the company scales — from planning and reporting processes to systems for finance, people, and GTM operations that don't yet exist

 - Drive cross-functional projects from ambiguity to execution, working directly with engineering, GTM, and finance to unblock progress and hold owners accountable to deadlines

 - Help run the operating cadence of the company: goal-setting, weekly/monthly business reviews, and org-wide planning

 - Get into the technical details where needed — jumping in to support different verticals

 - Identify gaps in how the company operates before they become urgent, and build the lightweight systems and processes to close them

 - Support hiring across the company as we scale the team
   
   


REQUIREMENTS

 - 2-5 years of experience in a high-ownership, cross-functional role; chief of staff, business operations, strategy & operations, management consulting, or founding a company

 - Experience at a hyper-growth startup, ideally one that scaled quickly and required building new functions and processes from scratch

 - Some technical fluency — comfortable having technical conversation, especially in the multi-modal data space, understanding basic infrastructure or model training concepts, or working directly with engineers, even if you're not an engineer yourself

 - Strong business operational instincts: comfort with financial models, dashboards, and translating ambiguous goals into concrete plans

 - High agency and a bias toward action. You should be comfortable picking up unfamiliar problems and driving them to resolution without much guidance

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent work-streams without dropping details
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building out a specific function (finance, people ops, GTM ops)

 - A technical background (CS, engineering, or a related field) even if your career has moved into operations or strategy
   
   


BENEFITS

 - 401(k) and full health insurance

 - Breakfast, lunch, and dinner covered, plus your choice of snacks

 - Ubers covered home

*All roles at Sieve require you to be onsite in San Francisco 5 days per week

jobs.title: Growth Operations Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sieve is a multimodal lab curating the world’s highest-quality training datasets, spanning video, audio, images, text, and 3D. We combine exabyte-scale data infrastructure with novel multimodal understanding techniques to push the frontier of foundation models. We exist to solve one of the biggest bottlenecks in AI: high-quality training data.

We partner with top AI labs and did $XXM last quarter alone, with a team of roughly 30 people. We raised our Series A from firms including Matrix Partners https://matrix.vc/, Swift Ventures https://www.swift.vc/, Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/, and AI Grant https://aigrant.com/.



WHY NOW

AI’s next wave needs data from people with real skills, creative expertise, and access to the physical world. Building a contributor network that can meet that demand is central to Sieve’s growth.

You’ll join early enough to build the systems that shape how contributors discover Sieve, start earning, and keep coming back. Your work will directly expand the data available to the world’s leading AI labs.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Growth Operations Lead to build and own growth for our contributor platform. You’ll run experiments to acquire contributors, improve activation and retention, and develop supply-side partnerships across physical AI and media generation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build from scratch. You’ll find creative ways to reach contributors, test what works, and turn successful experiments into repeatable systems. You should be equally comfortable launching a campaign, digging into funnel data, improving onboarding, and pitching a potential partner.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Run growth experiments: Develop and test acquisition channels across outbound, referrals, communities, content, paid campaigns, and unconventional growth tactics.

 - Build growth systems from scratch: Create the tooling, automation, tracking, and playbooks that turn successful experiments into repeatable contributor acquisition.

 - Improve activation and retention: Identify where contributors drop off, shorten the path to a first paid task, and build programs that keep them engaged and contributing.

 - Develop supply-side partnerships: Source, pitch, and launch partnerships with studios, creator networks, specialist firms, and organizations that can bring contributors and data into Sieve.

 - Expand supply across physical AI and media generation: Translate emerging project needs into targeted campaigns and partnerships that bring in the right skills, access, and expertise.

 - Own growth measurement: Track acquisition cost, conversion, activation, retention, and contribution quality; use the results to decide what to scale or stop.

 - Work across product and operations: Turn contributor feedback and experiment results into improvements to onboarding, communication, incentives, and the platform experience.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Consistent growth in qualified, active contributors who complete paid tasks

 - Higher conversion from signup to first paid task and a shorter time to activation

 - Stronger 30/60/90-day retention and repeat participation

 - Multiple repeatable acquisition channels with measurable costs and results

 - Active partnerships that deliver relevant contributors and usable data

 - Growth systems that support increasing volume while maintaining contributor quality




REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience owning growth, growth operations, or marketplace supply, with a track record of building programs from scratch

 - Demonstrated ability to design experiments, launch quickly, measure results, and scale what works

 - Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with funnel data, cohorts, dashboards, and acquisition economics

 - Hands-on experience with outbound tools, CRMs, lifecycle messaging, and workflow automation

 - Strong communication and commercial instincts; comfortable recruiting early contributors and closing partnerships yourself

 - Resourceful, self-directed, and willing to handle the operational details needed to get a new initiative off the ground

 - Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience growing the supply side of a marketplace, contributor platform, creator network, or expert community

 - Familiarity with physical AI, robotics, media generation, or AI training data

 - Experience building referral programs, contributor communities, or retention campaigns

 - Existing relationships with creative studios, professional communities, or organizations relevant to data collection

 - Ability to use SQL, scripting, or AI tools to analyze data and build lightweight internal tools
   
   


BENEFITS

 - 401(k) and full health insurance

 - Breakfast, lunch, and dinner covered, plus your choice of snacks

 - Ubers covered home

*All roles at Sieve require you to be onsite in San Francisco 5 days per week

jobs.title: International Field Operations Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sieve is a multimodal lab curating the world’s highest-quality training datasets, spanning video, audio, images, text, and 3D. We combine exabyte-scale data infrastructure with novel multimodal understanding techniques to push the frontier of foundation models. We exist to solve one of the biggest bottlenecks in AI: high-quality training data.

We partner with top AI labs and did $XXM last quarter alone, with a team of roughly 40 people. We raised our Series A from firms including Matrix Partners, Swift Ventures, Y Combinator, and AI Grant.




WHY NOW

We’re standing up data operations internationally — recording footage, hiring people on the ground, and building the local capacity those programs need. That work won’t scale from SF alone. We need someone who’s done on-the-ground ops and can expand teams internationally without waiting for a perfect playbook.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring an International Field Operations Lead to help build and expand Sieve’s on-the-ground operations abroad. You’ll help set up local collection (including recording footage), hire and manage people in-market, and turn early international efforts into reliable operating systems.

This is a hands-on ops role for someone with direct field experience — not a remote-only coordinator. You’ll travel when needed, solve problems in the moment, and build the teams and processes that make international data collection repeatable.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Stand up international ops: Help launch and expand on-the-ground operations in priority markets, including footage recording and related collection workflows.

 - Hire and grow local teams: Source, hire, onboard, and manage people in-market; build the staffing model as volume grows.

 - Own day-to-day field execution: Solve logistics, quality, scheduling, and vendor/partner issues so collection stays on track.

 - Build repeatable playbooks: Turn one-off market launches into documented processes for hiring, training, quality control, and escalation.

 - Partner with SF product and ops: Translate project requirements into field plans; feed back what’s working and what breaks in-market.

 - Scale carefully: Balance speed with quality, compliance, and contributor/operator experience as we expand.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Live international ops that reliably deliver footage and other required data

 - Local teams hired, trained, and producing without constant firefighting from SF

 - Clear playbooks for launching and expanding into new markets

 - Improving quality, throughput, and time-to-launch across sites

 - Strong coordination between field teams and SF stakeholders


REQUIREMENTS

 - Direct on-the-ground operations experience, ideally expanding teams internationally

 - Track record hiring and managing people in the field (contractors, vendors, or full-time)

 - Comfort with ambiguity, travel, and building systems where none exist yet

 - Strong operator instincts: logistics, quality, people management, and follow-through

 - Clear communicator across time zones and cultures

 - Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate; able to travel internationally as needed


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in data collection, media production, field research, marketplace ops, or logistics in emerging markets

 - Prior work standing up ops in multiple countries

 - Familiarity with physical AI, robotics, or AI training data workflows

 - Language skills relevant to priority markets


BENEFITS

 - 401(k) and full health insurance

 - Breakfast, lunch, and dinner covered, plus your choice of snacks

 - Ubers covered home



*All roles at Sieve require you to be onsite in San Francisco 5 days per week
